name: com.onefindme/search
title: OneFindMe
description: Search AliExpress and eBay in any language, build a budget basket, and read buying guides.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search AliExpress for products using the shopper's own words in any language (Hebrew, Arabic, German, Spanish, Japanese, …) — no need to know the English product name. Returns real listings with price, rating, order count, store and a link. Prices are for delivery to the given country. When eBay has matching new, fixed-price listings that ship to that country, they are returned as a separate list (ebay_results) with price, shipping cost, delivery estimate and where the item ships from, via the official eBay API. Links are affiliate links (OneFindMe may earn a commission; the price is the same for the buyer).

query.description: What the shopper is looking for, in any language, e.g. "מעיל חם לפעוט" or "wireless earbuds for running".

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the delivery country, e.g. US, GB, DE, IL, SA. Default US.

language.description: Language of the query and of the returned titles (ISO 639-1, e.g. en, he, ar, de). Default: detected from the query script, else en.

max_results.description: How many products to return (1-20). Default 8.

min_price.description: Minimum price in the country's currency.

max_price.description: Maximum price in the country's currency.

tools.name: build_basket
tools.description: Plan a set of complementary products for one need ("home gym starter set", "kit to start baking bread", "camping cooking gear") and fill it with real AliExpress listings whose total stays within the budget. Each item has a role (what it is for), price, rating, order count, a link and a few alternatives. Prices are for delivery to the given country, in its currency. By default only free-shipping listings are used, so the total is what the buyer pays for the items. Links are affiliate links (OneFindMe may earn a commission; the price is the same for the buyer).

need.description: What the basket is for, in any language.

budget.description: Total budget in the delivery country's currency.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 delivery country, e.g. US, GB, DE, IL. Default US.

language.description: Language for role names (ISO 639-1). Default: detected from the need, else en.

recipient.description: Who or what it is for, if relevant.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search OneFindMe's buying guides and how-to articles (about 1,200 pages in 21 languages: wigs and hair, shoe and clothing sizes, customs and import tax by country, home problems, gadgets, gifts, sales events, AliExpress shopping tips). Returns matching guides with title, URL, language, summary and section headings. Use get_guide to read one.

query.description: Topic in any language, e.g. "13x6 vs 13x4 lace wig", "מכס על חבילה מחו"ל", "taille chaussure chinoise".

language.description: Prefer guides in this language (ISO 639-1, e.g. en, fr, he, ar). Default: detected from the query script, else any.

max_results.description: How many guides to return (1-10). Default 5.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Return the readable text of one OneFindMe guide as Markdown (headings, tables, FAQ, links), by the URL returned by search_guides. Guides may contain affiliate links.

max_chars.description: Maximum length of the returned text. Default 12000.
